# Erdos.p126 — Erdős problem 126

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/126
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/126.lean`, theorem `erdos_126.variants.isLittleO`, AMS 11).

Erdős says that $f(n) = o(\frac{n}{\log n})$ has never been proved.

## Statement
∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hf : IsMaximalAddFactorsCard f), (fun (n : ℕ) => (f n : ℝ)) =o[atTop] (fun (n : ℕ) => n / Real.log n)

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
